purpose: Measure whether the trained decoder likelihood is sensitive to native P-to-location assignment beyond coarse RGB color-bin membership.

data.image_ids: first 64 IDs in the validated source97 seed1 TRAIN order

intervention.assignment: permute P rows only within each image
intervention.patch_rgb: mean of each native 4x4 RGB patch, divided by 255
intervention.rng: NumPy RandomState seed 150002, traversing images then joint bins in fixed order
intervention.gamma: held fixed and detached by the registered likelihood

readout.objective: unchanged registered SW0150 Gaussian mixture NLL
readout.sigma2: exact validated shared source preflight value
readout.assignment_shape: batch 1..4 by 1024 nodes by the model's native K (1..11)
readout.background_only: K=1 is valid and a row permutation is a no-op; classify no changed assignment rows as inconclusive
readout.padded_slots: if a batch/model contains zero-mass padded columns, permute complete P rows so padding remains zero and preserve the registered likelihood masking
readout.original_original_sanity: repeat original assignment scoring on the first image per model; require exact repeat equality

reported: eligible rows and occupied multirow bins
permuted row positions and rows whose assignment vector actually changed
per-image original/permuted NLL and paired delta
validated source, preflight, warm, model, and implementation hashes
interpretation: Descriptive objective-alignment diagnostic only. A worse permuted NLL does not establish causal necessity, segmentation quality, generalization, or promotion eligibility. If few rows are eligible or assignments do not move, report the intervention as inconclusive. No labels, GT, sweeps, model updates, or model-selection decisions are allowed.
